text: {"status":"complete","candidates":[{"dialogueCueIds":["c1","c2","c3","c4"],"contextCueIds":[],utterances":[{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c1","start":0,"end":26}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":0,"end":35}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":0,"end":29}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c4","start":0,"end":4}]}],"learningValue":"日常對話中詢問原因、解釋未完成動作被中斷（未完成過去時＋複合過去時）以及提出簡短請求的完整互動。","opportunities":[{"category":"grammar","sourceCueIds":["c2"],"description":"學習以「aller 的未完成過去時（imparfait）＋動詞原形」表達「正打算做某事」，並由 quand 引導的複合過去時（passé composé）切入表示中斷"},{"category":"grammar","sourceCueIds":["c1"],"description":"學習疑問句中的主語與動詞倒裝結構「Pourquoi es-tu...」"},{"category":"chunks","sourceCueIds":["c3"],"description":"學習口語請求時常用的動詞搭配「attendre un instant（稍等一下）」"}]}]}
